summary: Tested the new 'Editar datos de usuario' feature (nombre/apellidos/rut) on /estudiantes. Backend: 5/5 passed, 1 skipped (test_matricular_still_works skipped because /api/courses returned empty for module-level isolation — not a bug). Verified PUT /api/users/{id} as admin trims whitespace in nombre/apellidos/rut and returns updated public_user; empty nombre (after trim) returns 400; non-admin (student) gets 403; no-auth gets 403; existing toggle Desactivar/Activar via PUT {active} still works. Frontend: logged in as admin (OTP via db.otp_codes, token into localStorage key 'otec_token'). Searched for test user, clicked edit-user-{id}, verified dialog prefills nombre/apellidos/rut from row data, changed values and clicked edit-user-save → toast 'Datos actualizados' appeared, row reflected new name 'Juan Pablo Pérez Soto' and RUT '22.222.222-2'. Verified existing Matricular button present and Desactivar/Activar toggle still functions and updates row badge to 'inactivo'. Cleanup done.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_user runs db.update_one BEFORE checking if the user exists. For a non-existent user_id it is a no-op (modified_count=0) and then returns 404 — functionally OK but order should be reversed for clarity.

DialogContent in EditUserDialog triggers a Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Minor — consider adding <DialogDescription> for screen readers (also affects other dialogs on the page).

EditUserDialog apellidos input is not marked required even though create flow requires it; empty apellidos goes through PUT (backend accepts any non-None string, trimmed). Low priority — product may intentionally allow blanking apellidos.
RUT is accepted as a free text string without format/checksum validation anywhere (create, import, edit). If product requires valid Chilean RUT, add validation shared across endpoints.
test_credentials: admin info@iberoacademy.cl (passwordless OTP from db.otp_codes). localStorage key = 'otec_token'.
